title: TAI prebuilt rollback authority and incomplete deployment recovery
objective: Build and validate complete bounded rollback authority before any standalone TAI runtime mutation, recover only the explicitly attested incomplete deployment left by run 30813991271, distinguish direct role ACLs from intentional PUBLIC access, and then allow one exact-current-main standalone TAI deployment to complete without widening database, model, tenant, financial or runner authority.
boundaries: The recovery command is owner-only: /tai recover-incomplete-deployment current-main on issue 3365
Recovery requires exact-current-main full-stack production evidence, successful TAI controller sync and successful TAI REG.RU preflight
Recovery is limited to source deployment run 30813991271 and source SHA ba06e6067faebab23550db5f54d0f6eeab85550a
The source SHA must be an ancestor of exact current main and the protected checkout must be clean
The recovery script must prove the source state root, metadata, snapshots and mutation marker before any mutation
An accepted source deployment must never be recovered
Only the exact Compose service tai from the attested project may be removed
Only the dedicated TAI env file and TAI Compose override may be restored from source-run snapshots
The existing bounded direct-grant repair is reused only after service, env and override absence is proven
No DROP OWNED, REASSIGN OWNED, broad revoke, object deletion or grant is permitted
The source state is marked ROLLED_BACK only after service, files and tai_runtime absence are verified
Standalone deployment must materialize, hash and syntax-check rollback.sh before MUTATION_STARTED is written
Rollback must remove only the exact TAI service, restore exact file snapshots and transactionally revoke role-specific ACLs before dropping a role created by the same attempt
Rollback must preserve PUBLIC and every other database principal
Non-TAI isolation checks reject direct ACLs, ownership and memberships while treating intentional PUBLIC grants as platform-wide public authority rather than tai_runtime authority
Forward-only TAI migrations remain idempotent and are never down-migrated
No model, tenant, application role, financial or autonomous write authority is widened
The self-hosted runner remains non-root, outside the docker group and without direct Docker access
No Netlify, Vercel, Railway or paid LLM dependency is introduced
No new recurring cost
